segments.caption: In a minimalist, brightly lit studio, a man in a black jacket walks past a sleek, white, three-wheeled concept car, pushing it slightly before stepping away to reveal its full profile. The camera then cuts to a close-up of Danny Kim, the Founder and CTO of Lit Motors, who begins speaking while standing beside the vehicle, introducing the innovative electric car design.

Danny Kim, Founder and CTO of Lit Motors, stands beside and interacts with the company's white, futuristic two-wheeled electric vehicle, demonstrating its unique design and features in a clean, indoor studio setting.
A man enters and exits a sleek, futuristic white concept car in a studio, then walks with it into a cluttered workshop, where the camera briefly shows the car's exposed, complex mechanical interior.

A man in a workshop showcases a custom, white, single-seater electric vehicle, revealing its complex internal wiring and mechanical components. He then presents a large circular component, likely a wheel or part of the drivetrain. The video concludes with a dynamic street scene where the futuristic vehicle is shown in motion, maneuvering with agility next to a conventional car, highlighting its unique design and performance.

A man is shown working on a custom, futuristic, single-wheeled vehicle, revealing its internal components including large flywheels and battery packs. He then presents the vehicle’s unique design, which features a sleek, minimalist white body and a single large wheel. The video transitions to a simulation of the vehicle navigating a city street, demonstrating its maneuverability as it weaves around other cars, highlighting its innovative and unconventional design.

A man stands beside a white car, introducing a custom electric vehicle project. The video then transitions to show the car's modified underpinnings, revealing a dual-flywheel energy storage system connected to a battery pack. An animation illustrates the drivetrain, highlighting how the flywheels generate power during acceleration and regeneration. The final shots show the car's interior, featuring a MOMO steering wheel and foot pedals, indicating the vehicle is ready for testing.

The video segment provides a detailed look at the development of a custom electric vehicle, beginning with animated diagrams illustrating its regenerative braking system—showing how energy is captured during deceleration to accelerate the car to 15 MPH and then to 25 MPH. A man speaks beside a futuristic, white, three-wheeled vehicle, which is then shown driving down a city street before the camera reveals its complex, exposed internal wiring in a workshop.

A sleek, futuristic, three-wheeled electric vehicle is shown driving down an urban street, its minimalist design and compact form drawing attention. The video then transitions to reveal its complex internal mechanics, showcasing a tangle of wires and components beneath its smooth white shell. A digital display on the vehicle provides real-time diagnostics, showing status, battery life, and range, while a 3D animated cutaway illustrates its internal structure and battery placement, emphasizing its innovative, lightweight engineering.

The video presents a futuristic, compact, three-wheeled electric vehicle, initially shown through a digital dashboard display indicating its status and a warning that “FEET ARE DOWN.” The vehicle’s sleek, white, aerodynamic body is then showcased in various angles, revealing its transparent shell that exposes its internal components and colorful lighting. It begins with close-up shots highlighting the vehicle's aerodynamic, minimalist design, including its curved canopy, integrated cockpit controls, and distinctive white body with black accents. A man in glasses speaks beside a white car, transitioning to a cutaway diagram revealing the vehicle's innovative drivetrain, which includes a flywheel motor, capacitor bank, and gyros/generators, highlighting its advanced hybrid technology.

A man in glasses speaks beside a futuristic, white, three-wheeled vehicle, while animated diagrams reveal its innovative internal components, including a flywheel motor and capacitor bank. The vehicle is then shown in motion on a city street, driving past buses and other cars, demonstrating its real-world operation.
A man presents his custom-built, white, three-wheeled microcar, showcasing its unique design and mechanics in both an urban driving environment and a workshop setting.

A man in glasses stands beside a sleek, futuristic-looking white vehicle in a workshop, speaking while the camera cuts between his face and close-ups of the vehicle's rear wheel and disc brake, highlighting its mechanical details.

A man speaks beside a futuristic, white, single-wheeled three-wheeled vehicle in an urban setting, while a woman is seen opening the vehicle’s door, indicating the vehicle is being demonstrated or prepared for use.
A man gets into a futuristic, single-wheeled, pod-like vehicle on a city street, and then drives away down the road. The scene transitions to a news segment graphic for "Intel Free Press Tech News."

A sleek, futuristic three-wheeled electric vehicle with a transparent canopy drives down an urban street, showcasing its compact, aerodynamic design. The scene transitions to a title card for “Intel Free Press Tech News,” featuring a person in a lab coat holding an “EXTRA!” newspaper, setting the stage for a technology-focused report.
